 ARIZONA CARDINALS INJURY REPORT 
 Cardinals-Chiefs injury report: Carson Beck limited, Kenneth Walker III DNP
 The rookie quarterback dealt with back spasms earlier in the season. 
 BY ARIZONA SPORTS 
 Nov 19, 2026, 4:59 PM 
 Updated: 8:49 pm 
 14 
 Follow on Google News
 Watch: Bickley Blast: Why the odds are stacked against Carson Beck & the Arizona Cardinals vs. Kansas City | 9 mins
 The latest injury report for the Arizona Cardinals’ Week 11 matchup with the Kansas City Chiefs is headlined by rookie quarterback Carson Beck. 
 Beck was limited in practice on Thursday due to a back issue. The rookie quarterback dealt with back spasms earlier in the season, which caused him to leave a practice last month . 
 Starting center Hjalte Froholdt was a full participant after being limited on Wednesday. Froholdt sat out all last week due to a concussion. His absence required guard Hayden Connor to start there, and the guy ahead of him is Jon Gaines, who did not practice on Thursday after being a limited participant on Wednesday. 
 ADVERTISEMENT 
 Starting left tackle Jayden Williams, who did play against the Rams last week, was a full-participant after being limited on Wednesday. 
 Defensive lineman Walter Nolen III returned to practice as a full participant after not practicing Wednesday due to an illness. 
 For the Chiefs, running back Kenneth Walker III did not practice due to a groin injury. Walker, who missed practice on Wednesday, did not play last week against the Atlanta Falcons due to the injury. 
 Here is the full injury report for both teams:
